reviews.text: Love love love my haircut & blow out. Maria is the best! She’s super nice, professional and TALENTED. Do not hesitate to book an appointment with her. I will definitely be coming back.
Maria is great, she does a great job of giving me the results i am looking for. I always leave her salon with beautiful and healthy hair.
Maria! Her service is amazing! Every time I fly in from New York I book her immediately! The best hair wash everrr super relaxing and my hair always comes out fabulous!!!!
